service.description: Runs a validated parameterized SELECT against a configured customer database (MySQL / PostgreSQL / IBM Db2) and writes the result to a staged JSON file for reconciliation. Same contract as the OMS/Shopify extractors.

parameter.name: databaseSourceQueryId
parameter.description: DatabaseSourceQuery to execute (resolves its DatabaseSourceConfig connection).

parameter.name: lookupKeys
parameter.description: DAR-BE-386. Only the rows whose lookupKeyField holds one of these (a pulse asking which orders the target holds, an audit re-checking its open findings). The query still reads its window; the keys narrow it and never enter the SQL.

parameter.name: lookupKeyField
parameter.description: The result column lookupKeys are values of. Required with lookupKeys; a column the query does not return is refused.

parameter.name: lookupWithinWindow
parameter.description: Accepted for the by-key contract; a database query always keeps its window.
